{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
top_rows = sales_df.head()

# Display basic info about the data
data_info = sales_df.info()

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Display unique values in key columns
unique_customers = sales_df['customer_type'].unique()
unique_status = sales_df['order_status'].unique()

# Print results
top_rows, data_info, missing_values, duplicates, unique_customers, unique_status"}
